runtime_prompt_en:
A photographic fashion portrait of a reference-guided fictional woman, explicitly an adult, at a wizarding-school-inspired magical ceremony. The supplied photograph guides her face and hair only: a short dark bob, airy separated bangs, dark almond-shaped eyes, gently arched brows, a small softly rounded nose, full softly parted lips, and the small cheek mark visible in the reference. She has just received a house scarf and pauses within a visibly staged magical event in an ancient stone banquet hall. Her tailored black open-front robe reveals a crisp white shirt and a narrow deep-red tie with gold diagonal stripes; a knitted deep-red and gold broad-striped scarf rests around her shoulders. Her right hand lightly gathers the scarf at her collarbone; her left elbow bends comfortably, and her left hand grips one slender tapered wooden wand beside her shoulder, its tip directed upward and away from her face. A small white-gold light begins exactly at the wand tip and curves into a sparse constellation above that shoulder, illuminating the fingers nearest the tip. On a waist-high stone pedestal next to her, an aged brown fabric hat has a broad floppy brim, a crooked tapering crown, visible seams and worn patches. Its deep fabric folds form two eye hollows and a horizontal mouth crease, physically shaping a face in the hat. Several slim wax candles burn while hovering at different heights with clear air beneath them. Beyond the candles, the indoor vault appears as a deep star-filled night sky above heavy stone arches. She looks toward the camera with a quiet, slightly parted-lip poise; soft warm light brushes her cheek and the scarf yarn. A frontal eye-level three-quarter-length portrait keeps both hands, the wand tip, the complete hat and the starry ceiling visible. Face and tactile ceremonial clothing lead the image; the hat and luminous magical depth support it.
